items.decision: Team V2 is an organizational overlay, not a product engine
V1 worker execution remains the mechanical substrate
Accepted F1/F6/CCC/UX work is not repeated without regression/invalidation evidence
Organizational memory is backfilled from repository evidence only, never from recollection
items.evidence: AGENTS.md capability-evidence rule + TEAM-ORGANIZATION-V2-PROTOCOL.md V2 migration rule
items.note: Unknown history is recorded as UNKNOWN with its reason. No missing historical fact is inferred.

items.decision: REPORT-#### and RECOVERY-#### namespaces stay unbacked rather than gaining a ninth ledger
items.evidence: TEAM-ORGANIZATION-V2.json stable_ids vs TEAM-ORGANIZATION-V2-PROTOCOL.md memory-ledger list
items.note: Both namespaces are declared in stable_ids but neither has a canonical ledger. Creating one would introduce exactly the parallel governance hierarchy V2 forbids. No ledger was invented.

items.decision: Every memory claim is scoped to this branch lineage until the canonical lineage is decided
items.note: Naming the canonical lineage is MISSION_DIRECTOR/INTEGRATOR authority. An AUDIT-mode memory lease must not merge, rebase, move a branch or decide it.

items.decision: Wave 10 audits are not re-run; their unpromoted artifacts are cited by branch provenance instead
items.note: Re-running them would be duplicate work against a mission that forbids repeating accepted audits without regression evidence. The correct remedy is governed promotion by WORK-0004, not a new audit.

items.decision: A repeated execution of an already-attempted lease must be recorded, not silently repeated
items.note: This is the MEMORY_EDITOR deduplication mandate made enforceable: the Work Registry now carries WORK-0003.execution_attempts so the next dispatch sees that the lease ran once and was not promoted.

items.decision: Unpromoted worker-branch evidence keeps its worker-reported state but is labelled branch-scoped
items.note: A worker's self-reported state is preserved verbatim; only its reachability and provenance are annotated. Preserving failed and unpromoted evidence is mandatory; upgrading or deleting it is forbidden.

items.decision: Reused prior unpromoted ledger content as the baseline after independent re-verification instead of regenerating it
items.evidence: Capability Provider Leverage Law reuse order applied to organizational memory; EVIDENCE-0019 / EVIDENCE-0022
items.note: Reuse-before-rebuild governs process memory as well as product capability. Two prior attempts of this lease already produced a machine-verified baseline; regenerating it from nothing would repeat completed work and burn the wave budget. Adoption was conditional on re-deriving every material claim, which produced six corrections. This is reuse with verification, not trust.

items.decision: The unpromoted WORK-0004 root-cause reattribution is recorded as a pending memory correction, not applied
items.note: BLOCKER-0001 keeps its recorded title, status and evidence. Root-cause attribution and promotion are INTEGRATOR/MISSION_DIRECTOR authority, and the claiming lease is unpromoted and not QC-adjudicated. Recording a pending correction is the MEMORY_EDITOR duty; asserting it as fact would be memory fabrication.

items.decision: WORK-0003 must not be dispatched a fourth time at the same START_SHA without QC adjudication or promotion
items.note: Three executions of one lease are a governance cost, not a memory problem. The binding constraint is promotion and QC, which this AUDIT lease may not perform. Until WORK-0004 adjudicates and promotes, a further dispatch is duplicate governed work and must be refused by the ORCHESTRATOR.
